usage: The word '指紋' is a noun referring to the unique patterns on your fingers.
It is commonly used when talking about phone security features like fingerprint unlocking.
You can say '我用指紋解鎖手機' to mean 'I use my fingerprint to unlock the phone.'
In sentences, '指紋' usually acts as the subject or object of security-related actions.
It often appears with verbs like '掃描' (to scan) or '登記' (to register) in tech contexts.
